Liam —

Thanks for the PO and context. We can absolutely support a temporary "PDF bridge" while the portal is provisioned. High level plan:

1) Temporary signed PDFs: Redwood will email signed PDFs to ap-billing@apexhealthcare.com for invoices tied to PO #7921.
2) Entity headers: we'll mirror the invoice header you include on the PO. If you expect multiple invoice headers per billing period, please send a CSV mapping (entity name -> remit/PO).
3) Timeline: portal provisioning usually takes 7–10 business days after we receive the complete enrollment form and evidence. We can start the PDF bridge immediately once remit and VAT details are confirmed.
4) Sample: attaching a sample PDF template (temp-signed-invoice-template.pdf) showing where the signature and VAT fields appear. Please review and confirm.

Action items for Apex:
- Confirm the exact invoice header to use for this PO (legal entity + remit address).
- Provide VAT/EIN numbers to appear on the invoice.
- Confirm whether you want invoices to be addressed to a single AP inbox or split per entity.

Marissa (CC'd) will own enrollment and the checklist; Connor will support special-header formatting for multi-entity invoices.

We will treat this as an operational exception for the enrollment window and transition you to portal-only dispatch once set. Let us know if Net30 is a hard requirement for processing — we'll mark invoices accordingly.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Hi Liam —

Thanks for looping us in. Quick operational notes and a recommended checklist to make the temporary flow smooth. I've attached a short enrollment checklist (portal-enroll-checklist.xlsx).

Checklist (summary):
- Confirm billing contact and AP email (we'll send PDFs to ap-billing@apexhealthcare.com unless you ask otherwise).
- Provide entity mapping CSV for invoice headers (if multiple entities will be billed under one PO).
- Provide VAT/EIN numbers for each entity (we'll print on invoice line items where relevant).
- Confirm desired invoice numbering prefix (helps AP match).
- Confirm whether you need separate PDFs per entity or a consolidated invoice with breakdown.

Operationally we'll do this:
- Week 0 (today): Start sending signed PDFs manually once you confirm remit + VAT.
- Week 1: Complete portal enrollment (aiming 7–10 business days).
- Week 2: Verification and handover — during the canary week we'll send both a portal notification and the PDF copy for one billing cycle to validate reconciliation.

If your AP requires a stamped signature (not merely a digital image), note that our temporary PDFs will include a PNG signature plus the phrase "Signed on behalf of Redwood Inference". If you need a wet signature, we'll coordinate exception handling (slower).

Connor — can you confirm we can template per-entity headers and the expected filename convention for AP ingestion?

Liam — once you confirm the points above I'll trigger the PDF send and mark the PO as Net30 on our side.
